description: This file declares the HttpDecoder class and related components for decoding HTTP frames over QUIC, including visitor interfaces and frame parsing methods.

classes.name: HttpDecoder
classes.description: Main class for decoding HTTP frames exchanged in HTTP over QUIC sessions, with nested Options and Visitor classes.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Options
classes.description: Configuration options for HttpDecoder, such as allowing WEBTRANSPORT_STREAM parsing.

classes.name: HttpDecoder::Visitor
classes.description: Interface for handling parsed frames and errors during decoding.

methods.name: ProcessInput
methods.description: Processes input data, invokes visitor methods, and returns the number of bytes processed.

methods.name: DecodeSettings
methods.description: Decodes a settings frame from raw data into a SettingsFrame object.

methods.name: error
methods.description: Returns the error code if an error has occurred.

methods.name: AtFrameBoundary
methods.description: Checks if the current data ends on a frame boundary.

methods.name: DebugString
methods.description: Returns a debug string representing the current state of the decoder.
